summary: Demo Robot is a friendly service robot: a rounded white head with one wide cyan visor instead of eyes and two short antennae, a slate-grey body with orange joints and a round amber light in the chest. An adult robot, built and proportioned like a grown adult, about seven heads tall. Drawn as a clean anime illustration with flat colours.
adult: an adult robot, built and proportioned like a grown adult, about seven heads tall
